Within H4 use the ordered Boolean DAG terminal hit; overlap properness; capacity topness; a_alt equality; q cleanliness; target direct-hit/F/G/atomic/other. Each child includes the negations of all earlier siblings, so leaves are pairwise disjoint by construction. Exhaustiveness requires a symbolic theorem that every actual source supplies each queried typed guard and that every final target classifier has no residual outside hit/F/G/atomic/registered-other.
